$comment: v2.8 A17 (TunnelVision Q1, PR #55: two background writers skipped the read-only check every explicit tool passed). Every place under src/ outside src/services/ that names a World Info writer (a call, or a writer handed to a host port), with the guard that bounds it. src/runtime/lorebookWriters.guard.test.ts fails on a site with no row, a row with no site, an unknown guard, or evidence that is not in the code. Evidence is a literal the named file must contain; it pins that the guard is there, not that it runs before every write (tests do that).

guards.curator-scope: Stagecraft curator: only the story's stagecraft.lorebooks minus excluded and checkpoint-gated entries (isCuratorWritable), never a protected span or a new marker (protectedRefusal), re-checked at the write edge against the entry read there; creates never create a book and carry the so:created stamp; reverts are compare-and-set.
guards.gated-set: Checkpoint world_info: only entries of the story's gated set, replayed from the chat's path (worldInfoPlan / releasePlan); never an entry outside every gated set.
guards.normaliser: Scan mode's rest-off normaliser: only gated entries, recorded in the worldInfo.normalized ledger and verified against the files.
guards.mirror-ownership: Memory mirror: only the per-chat book it created or adopted (owned name, so-owner marker naming this chat), bound to this chat's slot only in file mode.
guards.wizard-create-only: Wizard provisioning: validateProvisioningOp before any write, the book created by this session or granted, re-read at the write edge.
guards.reaper-confirm: Deleted chat's mirror book: so-owner marker naming that chat, chat file confirmed absent, the player's yes.
guards.created-stamp: Deleted chat's curator-created entries: only entries carrying {{// so:created <that chat>}}, chat file confirmed absent, the player's yes, the stamp re-read before each delete.
guards.selection-confirm: Global lorebook selection: deselect only after the author's confirm, only books a library story lists.
guards.branch-slot: Chat lorebook slot: unbind only the parent's exact mirror book from an unadopted branch, under a RunGuard.
guards.scan-only: Activation on the scan copies for one generation; no file write.
guards.host-port: A writer handed to a typed host port; the port's consumer row carries the guard.
